channels.name: ┃community-guidelines
channels.topic: Detailed community guidelines and rules

pin.title: Community Guidelines
pin.description: Please read and follow these guidelines to maintain a positive and supportive creative environment.

fields.name: Respect & Support
fields.value:
• **Be Kind:** Treat all members with respect and kindness
• **Constructive Feedback:** Provide helpful, constructive criticism
• **Encourage Growth:** Support fellow creators in their journey
• **No Harassment:** Bullying, trolling, or harassment will not be tolerated

fields.name: Art & Content
fields.value:
• **Original Work:** Only share your own work or with proper credit
• **Appropriate Content:** Keep content suitable for all ages
• **No Spam:** Avoid excessive posting or self-promotion
• **Quality Content:** Share meaningful and relevant creative work

fields.name: Communication
fields.value:
• **Stay On Topic:** Use channels for their intended purpose
• **No Spam:** Avoid excessive messages or emojis
• **Respect Privacy:** Don't share personal information
• **Language:** Keep language appropriate and friendly

fields.name: Enforcement
fields.value:
• **Warnings:** First offense usually results in a warning
• **Timeouts:** Temporary restrictions for repeated offenses
• **Bans:** Permanent removal for severe violations
• **Appeals:** Contact staff if you believe you were treated unfairly

footer.text: These guidelines help us maintain a positive creative community!
